reason: My money already goes into index funds on autopilot every month and I barely look at it, so I don't have a problem an AI pet needs to solve. Paying a monthly fee on top of that, for a price nobody will even tell me yet, isn't something I'd sign up for.
objection: My broker already has free AI agents, and my set-and-forget plan works fine. I don't see why I'd pay extra and move real money to some future broker partner I've never heard of just to have a cartoon pet do what my automatic deposit already does.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran inside my existing broker account for free or close to it, and showed me in plain numbers that it actually beats my autopilot after fees.
